annotator_notes: eCRF 'form tracker', 913 pages. Two interleaved page types: (a) LAYOUT pages print the form title twice at the block and show field prompts with [n] slot markers; (b) 'Variable details' DICTIONARY pages list fields in a Name column with Export Name (OID), Type, Max length, and Categories (option values). Truth field = the Name-column entries on dictionary pages, and the prompt labels on layout pages. Category/option values, slot markers [n], Yes/No, and the running footer 'MAC186_...' are not fields. FORM SCORING RULE: dictionary pages carry no printed title, so form_name is set null there (form_source=carryover) and those pages are excluded from form-accuracy; only printed-title layout pages score form. CAVEAT: because each form has both a layout and a dictionary page listing the same fields, a field can legitimately be extracted on either page; per-page recall therefore slightly understates true recall for this document.
